_note: Bundled offline snapshot of well-known advisories for packages commonly used in AI applications. It is a demonstration baseline, NOT a complete vulnerability database. In production use the live OSV lookup (engines/risk.py::osv_lookup) or run `pip-audit`.

advisories.issue: torch.load(weights_only=True) could still allow remote code execution when loading an untrusted checkpoint.
advisories.fix: Upgrade to torch>=2.6.0 and only load checkpoints from trusted sources.

advisories.issue: LLMMathChain allowed arbitrary code execution through prompt injection.
advisories.fix: Upgrade langchain and avoid exec/eval-style chains on untrusted input.

advisories.issue: Bundled libwebp heap buffer overflow reachable through crafted WebP images.
A Session that made a request with verify=False kept skipping certificate verification for later requests to the same host.
Request body was not stripped on some cross-origin redirects.
The xmlattr filter accepted keys with spaces, enabling HTML attribute injection.
